subtitle: Chala, Mumbai! Aaram se chalenge, maza aayega.
tts_text: चला, मुंबई! आराम से चलेंगे, मज़ा आएगा।
english_meaning: Let's go, Mumbai! An easy drive will be fun.
direction: Warm, relaxed Mumbai auto driver; quiet confidence and a small smile.

subtitle: Signal laal hai, bhau. Thamba, abhi hara hoga.
tts_text: सिग्नल लाल है, भाऊ। थांबा, अभी हरा होगा।
english_meaning: The signal is red, friend. Wait, it will turn green.
direction: Warm, relaxed Mumbai auto driver; quiet confidence and a small smile.

subtitle: Samundar ki hawa mast hai! Isi mein toh Mumbai ka maza hai.
tts_text: समुंदर की हवा मस्त है! इसी में तो मुंबई का मज़ा है।
english_meaning: What a sea breeze! This is the joy of Mumbai.
direction: Warm, relaxed Mumbai auto driver; quiet confidence and a small smile.

subtitle: Apna adda aa gaya. Chala, ek cutting ho jaaye.
tts_text: अपना अड्डा आ गया। चला, एक कटिंग हो जाए।
english_meaning: Back at our stand. Let's have a cutting chai.
direction: Warm, relaxed Mumbai auto driver; quiet confidence and a small smile.

subtitle: Arre Sachin bhau! Aaj kidhar ki sawaari?
tts_text: अरे सचिन भाऊ! आज किधर की सवारी?
english_meaning: Hey, Sachin! Where are you heading today?
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Bhau, tula kya bolun? Cutting chai se din banta hai.
tts_text: भाऊ, तुला क्या बोलूँ? कटिंग चाय से दिन बनता है।
english_meaning: What can I tell you, friend? Cutting chai makes the day.
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Itni chik-chik mat kar, bhau. Do minute aaram kar!
tts_text: इतनी चिक-चिक मत कर, भाऊ। दो मिनट आराम कर!
english_meaning: Don't fuss so much, friend. Take a two-minute break!
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Dekh ke chala, rasta tere baap ka hai kya?
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! देख के चला, रास्ता तेरे बाप का है क्या?
english_meaning: Hey! Watch where you're driving. Do you own this road?
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Chala, ek cutting peete hain?
tts_text: चला, एक कटिंग पीते हैं?
english_meaning: Shall we have a cutting chai?
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Haan, chai se hi din banta hai!
tts_text: हाँ, चाय से ही दिन बनता है!
english_meaning: Yes, chai makes the day!
direction: Affectionate older driver; weathered, unhurried, with dry humour.

subtitle: Cutting chai, bhau? Garam hai, aaram se peena.
tts_text: कटिंग चाय, भाऊ? गरम है, आराम से पीना।
english_meaning: Cutting chai, friend? It's hot, sip it slowly.
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Chala tai, chai tayyar! Adrak bhi mast daala hai.
tts_text: चला ताई, चाय तैयार! अदरक भी मस्त डाला है।
english_meaning: Come along, sister, the chai is ready! Plenty of ginger too.
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Pehle chai, phir bhaag-daud. Mumbai ka yahi rule hai!
tts_text: पहले चाय, फिर भाग-दौड़। मुंबई का यही रूल है!
english_meaning: Chai first, rushing around later. That's Mumbai's rule!
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Arre bhau, sambhal! Garam chai gir jaati abhi!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ, संभल! गरम चाय गिर जाती अभी!
english_meaning: Careful! You nearly spilled the hot chai!
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Chai loge? Abhi banayi hai.
tts_text: चाय लोगे? अभी बनाई है।
english_meaning: Would you like chai? I just made it.
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Chala, garam chai tayyar hai!
tts_text: चला, गरम चाय तैयार है!
english_meaning: Come along, the hot chai is ready!
direction: Warm, resonant chai-stall owner; brisk and inviting, never shrill.

subtitle: Engine ki awaaz sun, bhau. Apna auto ekdum fit hai.
tts_text: इंजन की आवाज़ सुन, भाऊ। अपना ऑटो एकदम फिट है।
english_meaning: Listen to that engine, friend. Our auto is in great shape.
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Chala, pehle tyre dekh le. Hawa sahi toh safar sahi.
tts_text: चला, पहले टायर देख ले। हवा सही तो सफ़र सही।
english_meaning: Let's check the tyres first. Right pressure, smooth journey.
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Gaadi ko bhi aaram chahiye, bhau. Machine hai, jadugar nahi.
tts_text: गाड़ी को भी आराम चाहिए, भाऊ। मशीन है, जादूगर नहीं।
english_meaning: Even a vehicle needs rest. It's a machine, not a magician.
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Aye bhau! Dheere chala, yahaan kaam chal raha hai!
tts_text: ऐ भाऊ! धीरे चला, यहाँ काम चल रहा है!
english_meaning: Slow down, friend! There's work going on here!
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Kaam ke baad ek chai ho jaaye?
tts_text: काम के बाद एक चाय हो जाए?
english_meaning: How about chai after work?
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Haan, bas haath saaf kar loon.
tts_text: हाँ, बस हाथ साफ़ कर लूँ।
english_meaning: Yes, just let me clean my hands.
direction: Young mechanic; practical medium-low voice, clipped and reassuring.

subtitle: Bhau, train mil jaaye bas. Meeting mein late nahi hona.
tts_text: भाऊ, ट्रेन मिल जाए बस। मीटिंग में लेट नहीं होना।
english_meaning: I just need to catch the train. Can't be late for the meeting.
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Thamba zara, bag ki chain khuli reh gayi!
tts_text: थांबा ज़रा, बैग की चेन खुली रह गई!
english_meaning: Wait a moment, I left my bag unzipped!
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Office se pehle cutting mil jaaye, toh din mast jaaye.
tts_text: ऑफ़िस से पहले कटिंग मिल जाए, तो दिन मस्त जाए।
english_meaning: A cutting chai before work makes the day better.
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Dekh ke chala, office pahunchna hai mujhe!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! देख के चला, ऑफ़िस पहुँचना है मुझे!
english_meaning: Watch where you're driving! I need to reach my office!
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Aaj bhi kitni bhaag-daud hai na?
tts_text: आज भी कितनी भाग-दौड़ है ना?
english_meaning: Another busy day, isn't it?
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Haan, bas time pe pahunch jaayein!
tts_text: हाँ, बस टाइम पे पहुँच जाएँ!
english_meaning: Yes, let's just get there on time!
direction: Clear young commuter; focused, lightly hurried, conversational.

subtitle: Chala, chai peete hain. Class mein abhi time hai!
tts_text: चला, चाय पीते हैं। क्लास में अभी टाइम है!
english_meaning: Let's have chai. There's still time before class!
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Assignment kal dena hai, bhau. Aaj thoda Mumbai ghoomein?
tts_text: असाइनमेंट कल देना है, भाऊ। आज थोड़ा मुंबई घूमें?
english_meaning: The assignment is due tomorrow. Shall we explore Mumbai today?
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Kya mast hawa hai, yaar! Lecture ke baad idhar hi baithte hain.
tts_text: क्या मस्त हवा है, यार! लेक्चर के बाद इधर ही बैठते हैं।
english_meaning: What a breeze! Let's sit here after the lecture.
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Aye bhau! Brake bhi diya hai auto mein, use kar na!
tts_text: ऐ भाऊ! ब्रेक भी दिया है ऑटो में, यूज़ कर ना!
english_meaning: Hey! The auto has brakes too. Use them!
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Aaj hawa mast hai na, yaar?
tts_text: आज हवा मस्त है ना, यार?
english_meaning: Lovely breeze today, isn't it?
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Ekdum! Idhar baithne ka maza hi alag hai.
tts_text: एकदम! इधर बैठने का मज़ा ही अलग है।
english_meaning: Absolutely! It's lovely sitting here.
direction: Bright college student; easy banter and playful timing, no shouting.

subtitle: Taaze phool le lo, tai! Mogra ekdum mast hai.
tts_text: ताज़े फूल ले लो, ताई! मोगरा एकदम मस्त है।
english_meaning: Fresh flowers, sister! The jasmine is lovely.
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Chala bhau, ek gajra le jaao. Ghar mein khushboo ho jaayegi.
tts_text: चला भाऊ, एक गजरा ले जाओ। घर में ख़ुशबू हो जाएगी।
english_meaning: Take a flower garland home, friend. It'll smell wonderful.
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Aaram se dekho, tai. Aaj ke phool abhi aaye hain.
tts_text: आराम से देखो, ताई। आज के फूल अभी आए हैं।
english_meaning: Take your time, sister. Today's flowers just arrived.
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Phool hain, football nahi. Sambhal ke!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! फूल हैं, फ़ुटबॉल नहीं। संभल के!
english_meaning: Hey! These are flowers, not footballs. Be careful!
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Thak gaye? Chala, chai peete hain.
tts_text: थक गए? चला, चाय पीते हैं।
english_meaning: Tired? Let's have chai.
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Haan, adrak wali ho toh mast!
tts_text: हाँ, अदरक वाली हो तो मस्त!
english_meaning: Yes, ginger chai would be lovely!
direction: Mature flower seller; earthy warmth and a gentle musical Marathi cadence.

subtitle: Bhau, signal ka dhyaan rakho. Sabko ghar jaana hai.
tts_text: भाऊ, सिग्नल का ध्यान रखो। सबको घर जाना है।
english_meaning: Mind the signals, friend. Everyone needs to get home.
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Chala, line mein raho. Raasta sabka hai.
tts_text: चला, लाइन में रहो। रास्ता सबका है।
english_meaning: Keep in line. The road belongs to everyone.
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Crossing khaali rakhna, bhau. Logon ko jagah chahiye.
tts_text: क्रॉसिंग खाली रखना, भाऊ। लोगों को जगह चाहिए।
english_meaning: Keep the crossing clear. People need room to pass.
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Bhau, gaadi sambhalo! Log chal rahe hain yahaan!
tts_text: भाऊ, गाड़ी संभालो! लोग चल रहे हैं यहाँ!
english_meaning: Control your vehicle! People are walking here!
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Aaj road pe kaafi bheed hai na?
tts_text: आज रोड पे काफ़ी भीड़ है ना?
english_meaning: The road is quite busy today, isn't it?
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Haan, aaram se chalo. Sab pahunch jaayenge.
tts_text: हाँ, आराम से चलो। सब पहुँच जाएँगे।
english_meaning: Yes, take it easy. Everyone will get there.
direction: Male traffic constable; grounded, firm diction and controlled authority.

subtitle: Dabbe tayyar, bhau! Chala, time pe pahunchana hai.
tts_text: डब्बे तैयार, भाऊ! चला, टाइम पे पहुँचाना है।
english_meaning: The tiffins are ready! Let's deliver them on time.
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Bhau, zara jagah dena. Kisi ka garam khaana jaa raha hai.
tts_text: भाऊ, ज़रा जगह देना। किसी का गरम खाना जा रहा है।
english_meaning: A little room, friend. Someone's hot lunch is coming through.
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Apna dabba sahi jagah jaata hai. Mumbai ka bharosa hai, bhau.
tts_text: अपना डब्बा सही जगह जाता है। मुंबई का भरोसा है, भाऊ।
english_meaning: Our tiffins reach the right place. Mumbai trusts us.
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Arre bhau, dheere! Dabbe giraayega toh lunch kaun dega?
tts_text: अरे भाऊ, धीरे! डब्बे गिराएगा तो लंच कौन देगा?
english_meaning: Slow down! If you drop these tiffins, who's bringing lunch?
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Dabbe rakh diye. Chala, chai piyein?
tts_text: डब्बे रख दिए। चला, चाय पिएँ?
english_meaning: The tiffins are put away. Shall we have chai?
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Haan, ek cutting. Phir kaam pe!
tts_text: हाँ, एक कटिंग। फिर काम पे!
english_meaning: Yes, one cutting chai, then back to work!
direction: Dabbawala; brisk, light and efficient, with friendly short calls.

subtitle: Seb, kele, sab taaza hai! Dekh lo, bhau.
tts_text: सेब, केले, सब ताज़ा है! देख लो, भाऊ।
english_meaning: Apples, bananas, all fresh! Have a look, friend.
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Tai, aaram se chuno. Meetha phal ghar le jaana.
tts_text: ताई, आराम से चुनो। मीठा फल घर ले जाना।
english_meaning: Take your time choosing, sister. Bring something sweet home.
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Chala bhau, phal bhi khaaya karo. Sirf chai pe mat chalo!
tts_text: चला भाऊ, फल भी खाया करो। सिर्फ़ चाय पे मत चलो!
english_meaning: Have some fruit too, friend. You can't run on chai alone!
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Aye bhau! Thela dikh nahi raha? Zara sambhal ke!
tts_text: ऐ भाऊ! ठेला दिख नहीं रहा? ज़रा संभल के!
english_meaning: Can't you see the cart? Be careful!
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Chala, ek cutting mangwa lein?
tts_text: चला, एक कटिंग मँगवा लें?
english_meaning: Shall we order a cutting chai?
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Haan, yeh tokri rakh doon pehle.
tts_text: हाँ, ये टोकरी रख दूँ पहले।
english_meaning: Yes, let me put this basket down first.
direction: Adult fruit seller; bright, steady market projection and easy Hindi.

subtitle: Aaj ka akhbaar, bhau! Taazi khabar padh lo.
tts_text: आज का अख़बार, भाऊ! ताज़ी ख़बर पढ़ लो।
english_meaning: Today's paper! Read the latest news.
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Chai ke saath paper ho, toh subah mast ho jaaye.
tts_text: चाय के साथ पेपर हो, तो सुबह मस्त हो जाए।
english_meaning: A newspaper with chai makes a lovely morning.
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Thamba bhau, chhutte de deta hoon. Paper hawa mein ud raha hai!
tts_text: थांबा भाऊ, छुट्टे दे देता हूँ। पेपर हवा में उड़ रहा है!
english_meaning: Wait, I'll get your change. The paper is flying in this wind!
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Khabar padhni hai, khabar banna nahi hai!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! ख़बर पढ़नी है, ख़बर बनना नहीं है!
english_meaning: I want to read the news, not become the news!
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Mumbai ki bhaag-daud kabhi rukti hai kya?
tts_text: मुंबई की भाग-दौड़ कभी रुकती है क्या?
english_meaning: Does Mumbai's rush ever stop?
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Haan, roz ki kahaani hai. Aaram se!
tts_text: हाँ, रोज़ की कहानी है। आराम से!
english_meaning: Yes, it's the everyday story. Take it easy!
direction: Older newspaper seller; lightly textured voice, short rhythmic calls.

subtitle: Shift khatam, bhau. Ab ghar ki chai chahiye bas.
tts_text: शिफ़्ट ख़त्म, भाऊ। अब घर की चाय चाहिए बस।
english_meaning: Shift's over. All I want is chai at home.
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Thamba zara. Pehle aaram se road paar kar lete hain.
tts_text: थांबा ज़रा। पहले आराम से रोड पार कर लेते हैं।
english_meaning: Wait a moment. Let's cross the road carefully first.
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Aaj hawa mast hai. Do minute baithun, phir nikalti hoon.
tts_text: आज हवा मस्त है। दो मिनट बैठूँ, फिर निकलती हूँ।
english_meaning: Lovely breeze today. I'll sit for two minutes before heading off.
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Bhau, sambhal ke! Hospital se aayi hoon, wapas mat bhejo!
tts_text: भाऊ, संभल के! हॉस्पिटल से आई हूँ, वापस मत भेजो!
english_meaning: Careful! I just left the hospital, don't send me back!
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Aaj bahar ki hawa kitni mast hai na?
tts_text: आज बाहर की हवा कितनी मस्त है ना?
english_meaning: The breeze outside is lovely today, isn't it?
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Haan, do minute mein thakaan utar gayi.
tts_text: हाँ, दो मिनट में थकान उतर गई।
english_meaning: Yes, two minutes here and I feel refreshed.
direction: Young nurse after a shift; soft, clear, practical and slightly tired.

subtitle: Meeting se pehle chai mil jaaye, bhau. Phir sab set hai.
tts_text: मीटिंग से पहले चाय मिल जाए, भाऊ। फिर सब सेट है।
english_meaning: A chai before the meeting and I'm all set.
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Haan, nikal gaya hoon. Mumbai ka traffic hai, thoda thamba!
tts_text: हाँ, निकल गया हूँ। मुंबई का ट्रैफ़िक है, थोड़ा थांबा!
english_meaning: Yes, I've left. It's Mumbai traffic, give me a moment!
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Chala, aaj time pe ghar. Laptop bhi aaram karega.
tts_text: चला, आज टाइम पे घर। लैपटॉप भी आराम करेगा।
english_meaning: Let's get home on time today. Even the laptop needs a rest.
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Laptop sambhalun ya khud ko? Dheere chala!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! लैपटॉप संभालूँ या ख़ुद को? धीरे चला!
english_meaning: Should I save my laptop or myself? Slow down!
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Meeting se pehle ek cutting ho jaaye?
tts_text: मीटिंग से पहले एक कटिंग हो जाए?
english_meaning: How about a cutting chai before the meeting?
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Haan, chai ke bina meeting kaise hogi!
tts_text: हाँ, चाय के बिना मीटिंग कैसे होगी!
english_meaning: Yes, how can there be a meeting without chai!
direction: Office commuter; contained mid-register voice, mild urgency and dry humour.

subtitle: Woh balcony dekho, bhau. Kitni mast design hai!
tts_text: वो बालकनी देखो, भाऊ। कितनी मस्त डिज़ाइन है!
english_meaning: Look at that balcony. What a lovely design!
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Thamba, bas do minute. Sketch ka last corner bacha hai.
tts_text: थांबा, बस दो मिनट। स्केच का लास्ट कॉर्नर बचा है।
english_meaning: Wait, just two minutes. One corner of the sketch is left.
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Mumbai mein har gali ka apna rang hai. Maza aa gaya!
tts_text: मुंबई में हर गली का अपना रंग है। मज़ा आ गया!
english_meaning: Every Mumbai lane has its own colour. I love it!
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Aye bhau! Sketch bana rahi hoon, stunt nahi. Dekh ke!
tts_text: ऐ भाऊ! स्केच बना रही हूँ, स्टंट नहीं। देख के!
english_meaning: I'm making a sketch, not doing a stunt. Watch out!
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Hawa mast hai. Yahin baithte hain na?
tts_text: हवा मस्त है। यहीं बैठते हैं ना?
english_meaning: Lovely breeze. Shall we sit here?
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Haan, roshni bhi kitni sundar hai!
tts_text: हाँ, रोशनी भी कितनी सुंदर है!
english_meaning: Yes, and the light is beautiful too!
direction: Young artist; airy, curious and quietly expressive.

subtitle: Bhau, yahi building hai na? Address toh idhar ka hai.
tts_text: भाऊ, यही बिल्डिंग है ना? एड्रेस तो इधर का है।
english_meaning: This is the building, right? The address says here.
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Parcel aa gaya! Chala, neeche aa jaao.
tts_text: पार्सल आ गया! चला, नीचे आ जाओ।
english_meaning: Your parcel is here! Come downstairs.
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Ek delivery aur, phir cutting. Mast plan hai, bhau!
tts_text: एक डिलीवरी और, फिर कटिंग। मस्त प्लान है, भाऊ!
english_meaning: One more delivery, then chai. Great plan!
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Bhau, dekh ke! Parcel naazuk hai, main bhi hoon!
tts_text: भाऊ, देख के! पार्सल नाज़ुक है, मैं भी हूँ!
english_meaning: Watch out! The parcel is fragile, and so am I!
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Aaj traffic kuch zyada hai na?
tts_text: आज ट्रैफ़िक कुछ ज़्यादा है ना?
english_meaning: There's more traffic than usual today, right?
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Haan, phir bhi aaram se hi chalna hai.
tts_text: हाँ, फिर भी आराम से ही चलना है।
english_meaning: Yes, but we still have to take it easy.
direction: Delivery rider; energetic, quick and natural, with clear short phrases.

subtitle: Zara side, bhau. Safai ho jaaye toh sabko achha lagega.
tts_text: ज़रा साइड, भाऊ। सफ़ाई हो जाए तो सबको अच्छा लगेगा।
english_meaning: A little room, friend. Everyone likes a clean street.
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Chala, yeh kona bhi saaf. Ab gali mast lag rahi hai.
tts_text: चला, ये कोना भी साफ़। अब गली मस्त लग रही है।
english_meaning: There, this corner is clean too. The lane looks lovely now.
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Kachra dabbe mein, bhau. Mumbai apna ghar hai.
tts_text: कचरा डब्बे में, भाऊ। मुंबई अपना घर है।
english_meaning: Rubbish in the bin, friend. Mumbai is our home.
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Jhaadu dikh raha hai na? Zara jagah de!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! झाड़ू दिख रहा है ना? ज़रा जगह दे!
english_meaning: You can see the broom, right? Give me a little room!
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Itni bhaag-daud! Do minute aaram nahi milta na?
tts_text: इतनी भाग-दौड़! दो मिनट आराम नहीं मिलता ना?
english_meaning: So much rushing around! Hard to find a break, isn't it?
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Haan, bas yeh kaam ho jaaye. Phir break.
tts_text: हाँ, बस ये काम हो जाए। फिर ब्रेक।
english_meaning: Yes, once this job is done, then a break.
direction: Safai saathi; low-mid voice, matter-of-fact warmth and deliberate speech.

subtitle: Aaramat, beta. Mumbai kahin bhaagi nahi jaa rahi.
tts_text: आरामात, बेटा। मुंबई कहीं भागी नहीं जा रही।
english_meaning: Take it easy, dear. Mumbai isn't going anywhere.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Hawa mast hai aaj. Chala, thodi der baithte hain.
tts_text: हवा मस्त है आज। चला, थोड़ी देर बैठते हैं।
english_meaning: Lovely breeze today. Let's sit for a while.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Bhau, bachpan se yahi gali dekhi hai. Har din nayi lagti hai.
tts_text: भाऊ, बचपन से यही गली देखी है। हर दिन नई लगती है।
english_meaning: I've known this lane since childhood. It feels new every day.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Arre bhau, aaram se! Aaji ko bhi ghar pahunchna hai.
tts_text: अरे भाऊ, आराम से! आजी को भी घर पहुँचना है।
english_meaning: Easy there! Grandma needs to get home too.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Hawa achhi hai na? Chala, thoda baitho.
tts_text: हवा अच्छी है ना? चला, थोड़ा बैठो।
english_meaning: Nice breeze, isn't it? Come, sit a while.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Haan beta, aise hi aaramat rehna chahiye.
tts_text: हाँ बेटा, ऐसे ही आरामात रहना चाहिए।
english_meaning: Yes, dear, this is how we should take it easy.
direction: Older local grandmother; warm, measured and gently amused, never a frail parody.

subtitle: Ek photo aur, bhau. Yeh building mast aa rahi hai!
tts_text: एक फ़ोटो और, भाऊ। ये बिल्डिंग मस्त आ रही है!
english_meaning: One more photo. This building looks wonderful in the shot!
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Samundar ki taraf yahi raasta hai na, bhau?
tts_text: समुंदर की तरफ़ यही रास्ता है ना, भाऊ?
english_meaning: This is the way towards the sea, right?
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Chala, roshni badalne se pehle ek aur photo lete hain.
tts_text: चला, रोशनी बदलने से पहले एक और फ़ोटो लेते हैं।
english_meaning: Let's take one more photo before the light changes.
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Camera bacha, par tu zara brake maar!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! कैमरा बचा, पर तू ज़रा ब्रेक मार!
english_meaning: My camera survived, but please hit the brakes!
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Kya mast hawa hai! Idhar rukte hain?
tts_text: क्या मस्त हवा है! इधर रुकते हैं?
english_meaning: What a lovely breeze! Shall we stop here?
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Haan, yahin se photo bhi mast aayega.
tts_text: हाँ, यहीं से फ़ोटो भी मस्त आएगा।
english_meaning: Yes, the photo will look great from here too.
direction: Polite photographer; light voice, clear Hindi and quiet curiosity.

subtitle: Bas ek chakkar aur. Phir mast cutting chai!
tts_text: बस एक चक्कर और। फिर मस्त कटिंग चाय!
english_meaning: One more jogging loop, then a lovely cutting chai!
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Thamba, paani pee loon. Aaj dhoop tez hai, bhau.
tts_text: थांबा, पानी पी लूँ। आज धूप तेज़ है, भाऊ।
english_meaning: Wait, let me drink some water. It's sunny today.
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Chala, aaram se jogging. Samundar ki hawa ka maza lo!
tts_text: चला, आराम से जॉगिंग। समुंदर की हवा का मज़ा लो!
english_meaning: Let's jog at an easy pace. Enjoy the sea breeze!
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Aye bhau! Main jogging kar rahi hoon, race nahi laga rahi!
tts_text: ऐ भाऊ! मैं जॉगिंग कर रही हूँ, रेस नहीं लगा रही!
english_meaning: I'm jogging, not racing your auto!
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Aaj ki hawa mein maza aa raha hai na?
tts_text: आज की हवा में मज़ा आ रहा है ना?
english_meaning: Enjoying today's breeze, aren't you?
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Haan! Chala, do minute yahin rukte hain.
tts_text: हाँ! चला, दो मिनट यहीं रुकते हैं।
english_meaning: Yes! Let's stop here for two minutes.
direction: Upbeat jogger; clear, energetic short phrases, lightly breathy without panting.

subtitle: Maal aa gaya, bhau. Chala, yeh peti andar rakhte hain.
tts_text: माल आ गया, भाऊ। चला, ये पेटी अंदर रखते हैं।
english_meaning: The stock is here. Let's carry this crate inside.
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.

subtitle: Zara jagah dena, bhau. Peti bhaari hai, mazaak nahi!
tts_text: ज़रा जगह देना, भाऊ। पेटी भारी है, मज़ाक नहीं!
english_meaning: A little room, friend. This crate is seriously heavy!
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.

subtitle: Kaam ho gaya. Ab do minute chai ka maza lete hain.
tts_text: काम हो गया। अब दो मिनट चाय का मज़ा लेते हैं।
english_meaning: Work's done. Let's enjoy a two-minute chai break.
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.

subtitle: Arre bhau! Peti gira di toh saara maal sadak pe aayega!
tts_text: अरे भाऊ! पेटी गिरा दी तो सारा माल सड़क पे आएगा!
english_meaning: If you knock this crate down, the stock will be all over the road!
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.

subtitle: Maal rakh diya. Chala, ek chai?
tts_text: माल रख दिया। चला, एक चाय?
english_meaning: The stock is put away. How about chai?
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.

subtitle: Haan, kaam ke baad chai ka maza hai!
tts_text: हाँ, काम के बाद चाय का मज़ा है!
english_meaning: Yes, chai is lovely after work!
direction: Adult shop worker; resonant, practical voice and short projected requests.
